text_blocks.text: We got a new dude that was responsible for what was going on. It was basically my contract was coming up, so it was basically we're going to negotiate you while you're on the floor. quotes.excerpt: You don't want to negotiate with a dude like me. I'm an athlete, this is what I do.
quotes.quote: You don't want to negotiate with a dude like me. I'm an athlete, this is what I do. I like this type of back and forth. I thought we was family. If you're going to let the dude come in, I know how this is going to end. He's not smart enough in this tactical realm to go against me. Because if they fire me, I get all my Gil's Arena rights. Once we're done, I get my Gil's Arena rights, and I didn't want to wait to June 31st. I wanted you to do it in May.
